Heard on I.A.No. 1269 of 2025 , which is First application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. on behalf of appellant No.3 Sheela Bai Choudhary for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

This appeal is filed by the appellant being aggrieved of the judgment dated 25.07.2024 passed by 24th Additional Sessions Judge, Jabalpur, District Jabalpur in S.T. No. 419/2020 whereby the appellant No.3 Sheela Bai Choudhary has been convicted under Section 498A of IPC and sentenced to 3 years' R.I. with fine of Rs.500/-, Section 304-B of IPC and sentenced to life imprisonment with fine of Rs.1,000/- and also under Section 4 of the Domestic Violence Act and sentenced to R.I. for 2 years with fine of Rs.500/- along with default stipulations.

entities.text: 24th Additional Sessions Judge, Jabalpur, District Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that appellant Sheela Bai Choudhary is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is submitted that case of the present appellant is on the same footing as that of co-accused/ appellant No.2 Revti Choudhary, who has been enlarged on bail by Co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 16/12/2024.
There are good chances of success of this appeal.
The final disposal of the appeal 2 CRA-9697-2024 would take considerable time.

He,
therefore, prays for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the present appellant.
Learned Government Advocate opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the present appellant.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record as also maintaining principle of parity, without commenting on the merits of the case, we are of the considered opinion that this is a fit case to suspend the remaining jail sentence of appellant No.3 Sheela Bai Choudhary and to release her on bail.
